events.verdict: Jovic (MIA) is firming up over his left foot and he absorbs the contact with McDaniels (MIN) during the screen.
Conley (MIN) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Herro (MIA).
Highsmith (MIA) makes clean contact with the ball at the end of Edwards' (MIN) drive.
McDaniels (MIN) reaches over the screen and briefly places a hand on Jovic's (MIA) front, but the contact is marginal.
Jovic's (MIA) places his off-arm against Gobert (MIA) but he does not initiate any illegal contact that prevents Gobert from contesting.
Gobert (MIN) establishes himself in Highsmith's (MIA) path and does not deliver contact during the pick.
Highsmith (MIA) initiates contact to Conley's (MIN) right leg during his upward shooting motion, affecting the jump shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) briefly places his hands on Jovic (MIA) as he moves to establish rebounding position and the marginal contact does not dislodge Jovic from his position.
Conley (MIN) grasps and quickly releases Rozier's (MIA) left arm on the perimeter.
Edwards (MIN) moves into Highsmith (MIA) and initiates body contact that causes Highsmith to lose his balance after he secures the rebound.
Highsmith (MIA) deflects the ball away from Edwards (MIN) and is the last player to touch it before it goes out of bounds.
McDaniels (MIN) initiates illegal contact with Rozier (MIA) while he is airborne, affecting his layup attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Highsmith (MIA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Although Highsmith places a hand on McDaniels'(MIN) side during the put-back attempt, the contact is marginal. The basket is scored and Miami receives possession when play resumes.
Alexander-Walker (MIN) initiates illegal contact with Jovic's (MIA) head during the layup attempt.
Jovic (MIA) is turning slightly prior to marginal body contact occurring at the end of McDaniels' (MIN) drive.

Herro (MIA) commits a take foul on Conley (MIN). The contact to Conley occurs after he had gathered the ball, but before he has started his upward motion toward the basket. Since he pulls up for the shot outside the lower defensive box, a non-shooting foul was assessed.
Herro (MIA) and Adebayo (MIA) legally contest Conley's (MIN) jump shot attempt.
McDaniels (MIN) commits a take foul on Adebayo (MIA).
